title: From the Earth to the Sea
description: Exploring unrequited love and search for connection.
lyrics:
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
No matter where you go
No matter how you try to hide, baby
I said no matter where you are
I'm gonna find you from the earth to the sea
Oh, well, oh, well, oh, well, oh, such a perfect summer light
You appear in between sights
With a blink you vanish left this lightning in me
Heart flash, I gotta find you, return this spark
No matter where you go
No matter how you try to hide, baby
I said no matter where you are
I'm gonna find you from the earth to the sea
You told me you loved me forever
Now I need to find the coroner
To tell me if I'm alive
You left with all my heart
Now you're gonna know what juice and me
Think on the brink
There's no denying you can't leave me
We should end together
I've got these pills and a vengeance towards you
Come on, get together, chill
No matter where you go
No matter how you try to hide, baby
No matter where you are
You know I'm gonna find you, yeah, from the earth to the sea
No matter
No matter how you try, baby
No matter where you go and where you are
I'm gonna find you from the earth to the sea
Oh, so don't run, cutie, don't run
